tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia with slightly decreased hemoglobin and hematocrit. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further evaluation of anemia and platelet morphology/function may be warranted.
